Tell me what broke. Or tell me what you liked.

Both are worth sending. Pick which one this is and it lands in my inbox.

Goes straight to email. No account needed.

Why I ask for your email

Your message doesn't get sent from your email address, and it doesn't go on any list. It comes along with what you wrote so I can tell messages apart, and see when three of them came from one person instead of from three different people. That's the whole reason. Tick the box above and I will hit reply and write back. Leave it unticked and I will still read it, you just won't hear anything back.

One more thing: you can send three of these a day. That's plenty for one person and it keeps the junk out.
